newsitem.title: FRANCE: INSEE details components of French 1996 GDP.
newsitem.headline: INSEE details components of French 1996 GDP.

text.p: National statistics institute INSEE gave the following details on the 1996 gross domestic product (GDP) data issued earlier on Tuesday.
Fell 0.5 percent in fourth quarter after having grown 0.6 percent in previous quarter, revised from 0.9 percent. Up 1.6 percent year on year.
Rose annual average 2.1 percent, revised down 0.2 percentage point, contributing 1.3 percentage points to full year GDP growth.
Contributed 0.2 percent to full year GDP growth
Rose 0.4 percent in fourth quarter after 1.4 percent in third quarter.
Fell annual average 0.5 percent, revised from 0.6 percent given previously, giving full year negative contribution to GDP of minus 0.1 percentage point.

INSEE said the trade contribution to growth in the fourth quarter was insignificant, exports and imports rising more or less in the same proportions. Exports rose 1.3 percent and imports rose 1.2 percent. Exports were up 8.4 percent year on year and imports rose 5.7 percent. On an annual average full year basis, exports rose more than imports -- 4.7 percent against 2.5 percent and the trade surplus contributed 0.6 percentage point to GDP growth.
Stocks variation contributed 0.3 percentage point to growth in the quarter. Contribution to full year 1996 growth was negative 0.6 point.
Contributions to GDP growth based on 1980 prices
